bullet_points: Load the 10 galaxy and halo catalogs from the provided absolute paths.
Compute $R_{vir}$ analytically for each halo from $M_{vir}$ using the standard cosmological relation for mean matter density at $z=0$.
Match satellite galaxies to their host halos by matching the galaxy's `ln_M_h` (column 7) to the halo catalog's `M_vir` (column 6) within each realization.
Construct a master structured dataset containing host mass, derived $R_{vir}$, radial distance of satellites, and luminosity.
Pre-compute halo-mass-binned satellite counts and save the aggregated dataset to disk.
Implement a Poisson-likelihood framework to model expected satellite counts $\lambda(r | M, \theta)$ as a function of halo mass and radial distance.
Pre-compute the integration of the model over the halo mass function using spline interpolation.
Perform maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) to recover HOD parameters ($M_{min}, \alpha_{sat}$) by comparing forward-modeled counts to observed counts across all 10 realizations.
Compute confidence intervals for recovered parameters using variance between realizations.
Save the estimation results and parameter statistics to disk.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Forward Modeling and Likelihood-Based Parameter Estimation

bullet_points: Generate diagnostic plots showing empirical satellite radial profiles per mass bin.
Overlay the best-fit exponential model onto these empirical profiles to allow visual assessment of fit quality.
Save these plots to disk for reference in the final report.
Compute the marked correlation function $M(r)$ using luminosity as the mark, separately for the 1-halo ($r < 5$ Mpc/h) and 2-halo ($r > 10$ Mpc/h) regimes.
Normalize $M(r)$ by shuffling luminosity marks across existing galaxy positions to isolate spatial-luminosity correlations.
Plot the ratio $M(r)/M_{shuffled}(r)$ as a function of $r$ with error bands derived from the variance across the 10 realizations.
Save the marked correlation results and plots to disk.
Compute log-likelihoods for both a constant-$\alpha$ model and a mass-dependent concentration model.
Report delta-AIC values and interpret them using standard thresholds (e.g., $\Delta AIC > 2$ as meaningful, $> 10$ as decisive).
Calculate and map residuals between observed 1-halo clustering and forward-modeled predictions in the transition region ($r \approx 5$–10 Mpc/h).
Generate summary plots of the residuals and model comparison metrics.
Synthesize results from the likelihood estimation, marked correlation analysis, and residual mapping.
Interpret physical implications of recovered HOD parameters and spatial-luminosity correlations.
Discuss the validity of the Neyman-Scott kernel in describing the 1-halo to 2-halo transition.

Write the full Results section, including a summary table of recovered HOD parameters ($M_{min}, \alpha_{sat}$) per realization vs. ground truth, delta-AIC values, and marked correlation ratios at key radial bins.
